name: clickwitch
description: Render ClickWitch detail-page sections with your image tools or ChatGPT, then save and assemble them through the web editor.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, save and assemble ClickWitch detail-page images.
interface.longDescription: Connect to ClickWitch MCP for exact section prompts and ordered references. Use available host image tools or your ChatGPT UI, then browser/computer tools to save each image in the matching web section and verify the final vertical merge. Image tools and account access are provided by your host, not this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Generate images for this ClickWitch run.
이 ClickWitch run의 상세페이지 이미지를 만들어줘.
このClickWitch runの画像を生成して。
